subject.title: message_tool_only: withheld finals stay in the agent's context as normal turns, desynchronizing agent memory from what the user saw

question: Should withheld `message_tool_only` finals stay in model replay with an explicit undelivered marker, be replaced in replay by a concise notice, or be handled only through stranded-final recovery?
rationale: Source inspection supports the bug, but the durable representation affects privacy, transcript semantics, model behavior, and the active stranded-final recovery path.

options.title: Add Replay-Visible Undelivered State
options.body: Keep or summarize the private assistant text, but make later model context explicitly state that the user did not receive that assistant turn.

options.title: Replace Withheld Finals In Replay
options.body: Remove the private final text from model-facing replay and keep only a short notice that a final was generated but not delivered.

options.title: Rely On Recovery Only
options.body: Treat stranded-final recovery as the product answer and accept that replay context does not separately annotate older withheld turns.

recommendation.title: Add Replay-Visible Undelivered State
recommendation.body: Keep or summarize the private assistant text, but make later model context explicitly state that the user did not receive that assistant turn.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses runtime delivery, transcript semantics, and privacy behavior, and steipete has the strongest recent routing signal in the affected area.
